text_en: See, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.
text_cn: 看哪！有个君王将秉义为王，王侯也将秉公执政。

text_en: Each will be like a hiding place from the wind, a covert from the tempest, like streams of water in a dry place, like the shade of a great rock in a weary land.
text_cn: 个个将如避风的处所，避雨的遮盖，如荒漠中的水流，如旱干地上巨石的荫影。

text_en: Then the eyes of those who have sight will not be closed, and the ears of those who have hearing will listen.
text_cn: 看得见的眼睛不再矇眬，听得见的耳朵必将倾听。

text_en: The minds of the rash will have good judgment, and the tongues of stammerers will speak readily and distinctly.
text_cn: 急躁人的心将会体味智识，口吃者的舌将会畅于言谈。

text_en: A fool will no longer be called noble, nor a villain said to be honorable.
text_cn: 愚昧的人不再叫作贵人，奸险的人不再称为绅士，

text_en: For fools speak folly, and their minds plot iniquity: to practice ungodliness, to utter error concerning the Lord , to leave the craving of the hungry unsatisfied, and to deprive the thirsty of drink.
text_cn: 因为愚昧的人出言愚昧，心怀邪僻，肆意作恶，发表亵渎上主的谬论，使饥者枵（xiāo）腹，使渴者绝饮。

text_en: The villainies of villains are evil; they devise wicked devices to ruin the poor with lying words, even when the plea of the needy is right.
text_cn: 奸险者的手段毒辣，只筹划恶计，用诳言毁灭卑微的人，在穷人的案件上颠倒曲直。

text_en: But those who are noble plan noble things, and by noble things they stand.
text_cn: 但是贵人策划高贵的事，他常以高贵行事。

text_en: Rise up, you women who are at ease, hear my voice; you complacent daughters, listen to my speech.
text_cn: 图安逸的妇女们，起来，请听我的声音！无忧的女子们，请倾听我的言语！

text_en: In little more than a year you will shudder, you complacent ones; for the vintage will fail, the fruit harvest will not come.
text_cn: 稍过年余，你们无忧的女子必受惊扰，因为葡萄没有收获，谷粒一无收成。

text_en: Tremble, you women who are at ease, shudder, you complacent ones; strip, and make yourselves bare, and put sackcloth on your loins.
text_cn: 安逸的妇女们！你们必将颤抖；无忧的女子们！你们必受惊扰；你们脱光衣服，腰间缠上麻布吧！

text_en: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine,
text_cn: 你们必要为了肥沃的田地，为了结实的葡萄园而捶胸，

text_en: for the soil of my people growing up in thorns and briers; yes, for all the joyous houses in the jubilant city.
text_cn: 为了我百姓生满荆棘和蒺(jí)藜(lí)的土地，为了所有的娱乐家园，为了欢欣的城市而悲伤，

text_en: For the palace will be forsaken, the populous city deserted; the hill and the watchtower will become dens forever, the joy of wild asses, a pasture for flocks;
text_cn: 因为宫阙已荒废，喧扰的城市已荒凉，敖斐耳和巴罕永远成了废墟， 成了野驴喜乐的地带，成了羊群的牧场。

text_en: until a spirit from on high is poured out on us, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is deemed a forest.
text_cn: 及至神自上倾注在我们身上，荒野将变为田园，田园将变为丛林；

text_en: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness abide in the fruitful field.
text_cn: 公平将居于荒野，正义将住在田园。

text_en: The effect of righteousness will be peace, and the result of righteousness, quietness and trust forever.
text_cn: 正义的功效是和平，公平的硕果是永恒的宁静和安全。

text_en: My people will abide in a peaceful habitation, in secure dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
text_cn: 我的百姓将住安谧的寓所，安全的宅第，清静憩息之所，

text_en: The forest will disappear completely, and the city will be utterly laid low.
text_cn: 纵然丛林全被摧毁，京城全被荡平。

text_en: Happy will you be who sow beside every stream, who let the ox and the donkey range freely.
text_cn: 你们播种于多水之滨；使牛驴任意走动的人，是有福的。
